text:
Dear Lumen Health team,

I led the redesign of our appointment booking flow at a telehealth startup, successfully reducing drop-off rates by a third. This hands-on experience allowed me to efficiently utilize tools like Figma to create intuitive interfaces that significantly enhance user engagement. I am excited to bring this level of impact to the Product Designer role at Lumen Health. 

My work involved establishing a shared component library that has streamlined the design process across three product teams. This initiative not only improved design consistency but also fostered a collaborative approach to product development. I believe that a robust design system is crucial in delivering seamless user experiences, and I am eager to contribute my skills in this area at Lumen Health.

In my role, I conduct weekly usability sessions with both patients and clinicians. Gathering their feedback and insights has been fundamental in shaping our product iterations. I effectively turn these findings into prioritized backlogs, ensuring that user feedback directly informs our design and development efforts. I am particularly drawn to Lumen Health’s commitment to using research as a guiding principle for product decisions.

I am looking for a team where research shapes the roadmap, and I am confident that my background in user research and prototyping will make a valuable contribution to your mission of enhancing health through user-centered design.

Sincerely,
